parts:

probabilities when data are grouped in distance bins?

unrealistically g(0)/f(0). Does distance 6.0 use lower interval limits =

messages.subject: Re: distances used for detection probabilities
parts:
Francois-

See pages 62-64 of the Intro to Distance Sampling. The detection=20
function is integrated over the distance bin rather than using an end=20
point. You may also be interested in the following ms that describes the=20
situation where the bins vary.

Laake, J., R. J. Guenzel, J. L. Bengtson, P. Boveng, M. Cameron, and M.=20
B. Hanson. 2008. Coping with variation in aerial survey protocol for=20
line-transect sampling. Wildlife Research 35:289-298.

regards --jeff
